# Kettlebell Only Muscle Gain (KBOMG)

> > Kettlebell-exclusive muscle building programs and training resources by Joe Daniels, featuring structured workout plans from beginner to advanced levels.

KBOMG (Kettlebell Only Muscle Gain) offers comprehensive kettlebell training programs ranging from 4-16 weeks, designed specifically for muscle gain using single and double kettlebell techniques. Created by Joe Daniels of SwingTHISKettlebell, the site features 1700+ training videos, free workouts, and specialized programs including the Outer Limits Protocol, STKB Complexes, and Double KB Precision.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell Muscle Gain
- Joe Daniels / SwingTHISKettlebell
- KBOMG Programs

## Exercise Technique Guides

- [All About the Kettlebell Swing](https://kbmuscle.com/f/all-about-the-kettlebell-swing-from-beginner-to-advanced-levels): Complete kettlebell swing guide from beginner to advanced levels
- [Ultimate Guide to the Kettlebell Snatch](https://kbmuscle.com/f/ultimate-guide-to-the-kettlebell-snatch): Ultimate guide to mastering the kettlebell snatch exercise technique
- [20 Questions on the Kettlebell Swing](https://kbmuscle.com/blog/f/20-questions-on-the-kettlebell-swing): 20 common kettlebell swing questions answered for all skill levels
- [Fixing Your Kettlebell Swings & 10 Alternatives](https://kbmuscle.com/blog/f/how-to-do-a-kettlebell-swing-plus-kettlebell-swing-alternatives): Kettlebell swing form corrections and 10 alternative exercises
- [Three Tips to Improve Clean and Snatch](https://kbmuscle.com/blog/f/big-tip-to-improve-your-kettlebell-training-clean-and-snatch): Three tips to improve kettlebell clean and snatch ballistic techniques

## Advanced Training Articles
